charts.title: What healing really looked like
charts.sub: My real timeline after 9 procedures in 1 day. Yours may be different.

items.d: Could not open my eyes. A nurse stayed with me 24/7.
Bandages off. Swollen, 1 eye crossed. I cried.
Neck felt so tight it was hard to swallow.
Flew home. My surgeon advises 14 days.
Stayed home. Watery eyes, sunglasses outside.
The real results finally started to show.
When I will judge the final result.

blocks.label: My rule:
blocks.text: Plan for 3 months of hiding, not 2 weeks.
